page.layout: One block of text in a single column, with a full-width heading "Caput Secundum." below a rule, then the opening of the chapter with a woodcut initial and a closing verse reference at the right. Running head at top centre; page number at top left.

l.i: Verf. 19. Alium autem ex apostolis non vidi quenquam,

main_text.l: Quintum signum, quod satis institutus in mysterio salutis per CHRI-
STUM ipsum immediate; non adierit Apostolos ante se vocatos, sed
Euangelium in Arabia, & Damasci, primo triennio sui Apostolatus
prædicaverit.
Et post
triennium, Hierosolymam profectus, inviserit Petrum &
Iacobum solos, paucos apud eos dies commoratus, idque familiaritatis, non
cognitionis suæ confirmandæ causâ.

l.i: Vers. 20. In iis porrò quæ scribo vobis, ecce coram Deo,

main_text.l: In cujus historiæ confirmationem, præter testes in vivis agentes,
qui rei tam notabilis ignari esse non poterant, juramentum adhibet.

l.i: Vers. 21. Deinde veni in regiones Syriæ & Ciliciæ.
Vers. 22. Eram autem ignotus facie Ecclesiis Judææ, quæ erant in Christo;

main_text.l: Vers. 23. Sed solùm audierant qui dicerent, Qui persequeba-tur

l.i: nos aliquando, nunc annuntiat fidem quam olim vastabat.
Vers. 24. Et glorificabant Deum de me.

main_text.l: Sextum signum, quod publicè docuerit, idque Apostolicâ autoritate
in Syria, & Ciliciâ, approbantibus Apostolis, & Ecclesiis omnibus,
& nominatim Judæis fidelibus, qui ipsum nunquam viderant, de ipsius
tamen conversione à persecutore in prædicatorem certiores facti,
Deum glorificabant. Quæ omnia signa, fidem faciunt de Doctrinæ
ipsius cœlesti origine.
Caput Secundum.
VÆ sunt Capitis partes, In prima pergit historiam texere quam narrabat, &
Apostolatus sui, seu divinæ doctrinæ suæ, signa reliqua adaere, ad vers. 15. Reliqun
capite, justitiam esse ex fide, & non ex operibus legis, confirmat.

page.notes: Woodcut initial "D" (decorated) at the start of the chapter. The opening word of the chapter's first line is printed as a large initial "VÆ" with the rest of the word forms part of the same line; the initial letter is shown as a decorated D in the image and is transcribed as printed. Several words in the Verf. 23 and 24 lines are set in different type. Verf. 24 line ends with a mark. Some words in the Sextum paragraph are partly obscured by print show-through and are copied as they appear.
